exposure: Low molecular weight heparin (LMWH) 40 mg daily
Low molecular weight heparin (LMWH) 40 mg on alternate days
cohort: The study included 122 women aged 30-45 years with a history of adverse obstetric outcomes, enrolled in the first trimester when fetal cardiac activity became positive.
finding: The study found no significant difference in live birth rates between women receiving daily versus alternate-day LMWH, but daily LMWH was associated with significantly higher neonatal intensive care unit admissions.
mod_finding: No significant differences were observed between the LMWH groups in terms of mode of delivery (Spontaneous vaginal delivery or Cesarean section).
followup_time: N/A (outcomes assessed at birth and immediate postnatal period)
gest_age: Mean gestational age at enrolment was 9.95 ± 1.14 weeks, but gestational age at birth for the babies included in the outcome is N/A.
